availability.statement: Fund-fee data is restricted to enterprise or institutional access; a 403 means this credential is not entitled to the requested capability.

common_pitfalls: Fund metadata and metrics are both part of the restricted fund-fee capability.
A valid ticker can still return an entitlement error for the current credential.
description: Mutual-fund and ETF metadata plus current and historical fee metrics.
ticker_format: Uppercase mutual-fund or ETF symbol, e.g. VFIAX
workflows: Fetch fund metadata to confirm the identifier and available fee context.
Use fee metrics for the current and historical fee series after entitlement is confirmed.
